list.name: test_id_a
list.label: Server A
list.query: SELECT test_id FROM test_runs ORDER BY created_at DESC

list.name: test_id_b
list.label: Server B
list.query: SELECT test_id FROM test_runs ORDER BY created_at DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Entry' AS metric, entry_score AS a_score, NULL AS b_score FROM test_runs WHERE test_id = '$test_id_a' UNION ALL SELECT 'Entry', NULL, entry_score FROM test_runs WHERE test_id = '$test_id_b' UNION ALL SELECT 'Exit', exit_score, NULL FROM test_runs WHERE test_id = '$test_id_a' UNION ALL SELECT 'Exit', NULL, exit_score FROM test_runs WHERE test_id = '$test_id_b' UNION ALL SELECT 'Relay', relay_score, NULL FROM test_runs WHERE test_id = '$test_id_a' UNION ALL SELECT 'Relay', NULL, relay_score FROM test_runs WHERE test_id = '$test_id_b' UNION ALL SELECT 'Overall', overall_score, NULL FROM test_runs WHERE test_id = '$test_id_a' UNION ALL SELECT 'Overall', NULL, overall_score FROM test_runs WHERE test_id = '$test_id_b'
SELECT test_id, asn, as_name, location, provider, distro, ipv4_masked, overall_score, detected_techniques FROM test_runs WHERE test_id = '$test_id_a' LIMIT 1
SELECT test_id, asn, as_name, location, provider, distro, ipv4_masked, overall_score, detected_techniques FROM test_runs WHERE test_id = '$test_id_b' LIMIT 1

SELECT '$test_id_a' AS server, category, method, COUNT(*) AS detections FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs run ON run.id = tr.test_run_id WHERE run.test_id = '$test_id_a' AND method IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, method UNION ALL SELECT '$test_id_b', category, method, COUNT(*) FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs run ON run.id = tr.test_run_id WHERE run.test_id = '$test_id_b' AND method IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, method ORDER BY method, category
